# asset-fetch

> Typed CLI and library for finding, verifying, extracting and curating game assets
> from itch.io, Poly Haven and a local SQLite catalog. ESM and CommonJS, Node 24 or newer.

## Documentation

- [Documentation site](https://jbcom.github.io/asset-fetch/): browsable guides and reference.
- [README](https://github.com/jbcom/asset-fetch/blob/main/README.md): installation and quick start.
- [API](https://github.com/jbcom/asset-fetch/blob/main/docs/API.md): public exports and options.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/jbcom/asset-fetch/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): module boundaries and safety invariants.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/jbcom/asset-fetch/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): diagnostics and recovery.
- [Agent notes](https://github.com/jbcom/asset-fetch/blob/main/AGENTS.md): toolchain and development invariants.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/jbcom/asset-fetch/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): validation and commit conventions.
